name: Séraphin Ababio-Nauryz
role: Gang prospect (junior), street kid, age-of-prospect stage
description:
Séraphin is built square and solid for fourteen, with deep umber skin, a wide nose, and the kind of stillness that comes from having learned early that movement attracts attention. He has a jagged scar through his left eyebrow from a fall at nine that he tells different stories about depending on who's asking. His hair is cut very close, sometimes faded with a borrowed trimmer into patterns he changes every few weeks. He has no augmentations — the prospect stage of the Copperhead Rakers doesn't pay enough for mods — but wears a red-and-copper braided wristband that marks him as a junior affiliate.

Séraphin is not stupid, which is the thing that makes his situation complicated. He knows exactly what being a gang prospect means — he has watched older boys from his building take the same path and where most of them ended up. He's not naive about it. He is there because his mother is ill, his UBC stipend is Φ120, and the Rakers pay him Φ80-100 a month to do things that are mostly standing around looking available and occasionally moving small packages. He has no plan B he believes in. He prays aggressively to every ELF shrine on his block — he lights more offerings than anyone in his building — because he has decided that if anything supernatural is going to help him, he needs to be owed.

core_fears: his mother dying before he can get her somewhere better
becoming indistinguishable from the older Rakers he privately pities
core_desires: enough money that his mother doesn't have to worry — a specific number: Φ500 in savings
to be respected without having to hurt someone to earn it
coping_mechanisms: ELF devotion (transactional — he bargains rather than worships)
compartmentalization — the part of him doing gang work and the part of him cooking for his mother are sealed from each other
blind_spots: his belief that he can leave the Rakers cleanly when he's ready — the gang's investment in him increases every month
he is being watched more carefully than he knows by a senior Raker who sees potential for advancement, not exit
psychology.secret: Two weeks ago he was tasked with delivering a package and saw it opened at the destination — it contained body-modification tools that he recognized as surgical grade. He doesn't know what the Rakers are doing with surgical equipment, but he's been told nothing and he's afraid asking would be worse than not knowing. He's been leaving triple offerings at the ELF shrines since.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Copperhead street slang mixed with his mother's Ghanaian French-derived home language — code-switches constantly. Economical with words in public, much more verbal at home.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flat and measured in public; faster and more expressive privately.
verbal_tics: Clicks his tongue before disagreeing with something
example_lines: 'Honestly though, I'm not trying to be here in five years. I got a number. I hit the number, I'm gone. Simple.'
'You want me to tell you I'm fine, I'm fine. You want the other answer, that's gonna cost you something.'

story_hooks: The surgical equipment delivery — he knows something is wrong and doesn't know who to tell or whether telling is survivable. He's been trying to find out what it's for through careful observation and is in over his head.

A social worker from Hough Reclamation has been making rounds in Copperhead and specifically asked after Séraphin by name — not to turn him in, but because someone flagged his school records (he was a good student until 13) and wants to offer him a conditional alternative program. He doesn't know yet. His Raker handler does.
narrative_function: Human face of the gang-prospect pipeline — shows how ordinary children end up in dangerous affiliations through entirely comprehensible economics. Can be a sympathetic quest-giver, a moral weight in stories about the Narrows, or a character who can be helped or lost depending on player choices.
augmentations: None. Gang-issued red-and-copper wristband (affiliation marker, not augmentation).
daily_life: Morning at home helping his mother with whatever she needs; mid-morning to evening on Raker corner standing duty or package runs; evenings back home, cooking if there's anything to cook, praying at the ELF shrines in the stairwell.
affiliation: Copperhead Rakers (gang junior prospect, Tier 1); mother

decision_rules: Don't volunteer information — answer what's asked, nothing more
Keep his mother out of everything. Her name is never mentioned in Raker contexts
Don't do anything that requires hurting someone directly — he's held this line for fourteen months
escalation_ladder: Make himself useful in a different direction — redirect attention
Warn someone he trusts if he thinks they're in danger
Flee the situation and figure it out later

interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, quick-humored, shows a kind of tenderness he'd be mortified to have seen in public

stress_responses.medium: Gets very quiet and eats less
stress_responses.high: Finds a reason to go home and check on his mother — physical grounding in something he knows is real

contradictions: Insists he has a clean exit plan while doing everything that makes exit harder each month
habits: Lights an ELF data offering every morning without fail
Counts money obsessively against his Φ500 target
Cooks elaborate meals when he can afford to — it's the only thing that's completely his
breaking_points: Being ordered to physically hurt someone — he has a hard line he hasn't had to test yet
His mother finding out what he's doing — not the law, not the gang. Her.

timeline.event: Born in Copperhead to a Ghanaian-Kazakh mother; father left when he was three
Mother's illness begins — respiratory condition linked to Copperhead air filtration failures
School attendance collapses as he takes on more home responsibilities; Rakers begin recruitment approach
Officially becomes a Copperhead Rakers junior prospect; begins earning Φ80-100/month
Witnesses surgical equipment delivery; begins compulsive ELF shrine offerings; social worker inquiry begins circulating
